title: Qonclave node manifest
description: What a node advertises about itself. COMMUNICATION.md §1. Carried in mDNS TXT records, UDP discovery broadcasts, and check-in uplinks. Nodes on the `minimal` profile never broadcast this — they are commissioned out-of-band and known to their hub already.

endpoints.description: How to reach this node, keyed by transport scheme. A node behind a non-IP link (LoRa, BLE) may advertise no endpoints at all and be reachable only via its commissioning hub.

accepts_foreign_edges.description: Hubs only. True if this hub will accept events from an edge node commissioned by a different hub, provided it presents a valid capability grant naming this hub as audience.

trusted_issuers.description: Hubs only. node_ids of peer hubs whose CA roots this hub has pinned during federation, and whose grants it will therefore verify offline.
